description: Source code for license management API endpoints in Mattermost, including adding, removing, and retrieving license information.

methods.name: InitLicenseLocal
methods.description: Initializes API routes for license management: add, remove, and get client license.

methods.name: localAddLicense
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a new license file.

methods.name: localRemoveLicense
methods.description: Handles removal of the current license.

methods.name: localGetClientLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the client license in specified format.
